request.question: How many receipts did the Mining and Energy Union make?

context.author: user
context.text: How much has the Mining and Energy Union donated?

context.author: answer
context.text:
Mining and Energy Union provided $4,720,421 in federal disclosed receipts to all recipient parties in financial years 1998-99 to 2025-26.

Mining and Energy Union provided $4,720,421 in federal disclosed receipts to Labor in financial years 1998-99 to 2025-26.

Mining and Energy Union provided $4,102,022 in federal disclosed receipts to all recipient parties in financial years 2024-25.

Mining and Energy Union provided $500,000 in federal disclosed receipts to all recipient parties in financial years 2021-22.

Mining and Energy Union provided $93,954 in federal disclosed receipts to all recipient parties in financial years 2002-03.

Mining and Energy Union provided $8,149 in federal disclosed receipts to all recipient parties in financial years 2001-02.

Mining.

response.answer: The Mining and Energy Union made 56 disclosed receipts to all recipient parties across financial years 1998-99 to 2025-26, a federal total of $4,720,421.

request.question: Are internal party transfers counted in the $4,720,421?
